title: Lower rational FFT circuits to fixed Hadamard stages
body:
I connect the actual rational FFT and stored adjoint from PR4205 to the retained six-Hadamard/seven-diagonal words and Beneš routing. The older FFT word has a different matrix endpoint. I use the existing nonzero-shear helper to lower the rational butterfly, preserve the word count, and charge the H/2 normalization, inactive words and each emitted rounding site.

For a dyadic field, arbitrary ordered active FFT wires, input radius R, target 2^-t and incoming grid F0, I prove a prefix/inverse-prefix bound K=2^14 independent of the number of completed FFT layers. I give an explicit common coefficient/data grid with O(F0+t+log N+log R) signed widths and error below 3*2^-t/4 against the normalized DFT or its adjoint, under the retained certified phase contract. PROOF.md separates the original phase error from the new coefficient and data errors.

I start from current main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority 7. I preserve completed PR4205 at `78c72e563173f3822fcb4efed9ceeccf05630258`, retaining its two producer files unchanged with original provenance and a separate local archive pin.

I check 13 cases through 64 wires, 2,525 primitive stages and 73,104 rounded outputs. I compare exact complete endpoints, basis matrices through eight wires and direct Fourier interval formulas. Sixteen standalone words cover 1,456 exact segments and their inverses; 23 controls pass. A 512-bit spectator has nonzero rounding error within the budget. The scientific digest is `d735321b0bf6457ad884779b5854ff201e18f79e4bf8df8b32da6f91477b4c9d`.

Reproduce with CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rational-fft-fixed-h
```

I declare normal and optimized checks with a 120-second limit each. The registered checks pass locally. I have also passed committed-byte and source-history checks for 18 payload files and export integrity at head `6f17e6208a78cfade27f5c8f03383256f586ab24`.

Both Git-free checks pass in 3.106 and 3.096 seconds, with all 19 exported files unchanged. Archive SHA256: `c90737441543a6695982a2b8c64b8db8d774f5d07ea5f3b2dc38be5a3d467618`; receipt SHA256: `35af38b18c31582902d81404e6d3fc5ddf5bf90438ebf78ba1c5fc7f6d382e04`. Before submission I refreshed unchanged canonical main and checked eight recent PR records, 5/927 hub comments and the canonical thread. James Reed's new claim concerns a separate finite audit of PR4178.

I matched both scientific records and the complete digest from the successful [hosted run39500091244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39500091244) to the export. GitHub also passed the unchanged-input check. I verified test merge `cc2863d6efddf19bbcb79e871d1a1fe4f45caa59`, its exact base/head parents and publication tree `cb1959a22aba2bde512187f17a4b54bb3f2403da`.

I execute mathematical H/2 arithmetic with fixed-grid rounding. Actual T74 supplier execution, complete-stream tensor admission, coefficient delivery and tape costs remain open. The rounded forward and adjoint programs generally are not exact inverses. The direct Fourier comparison shares the declared phase backend, and reviewers still need to assess the quantified proof. I claim no new multiplication exponent.

I credit Vlado Vojdanovski for the words, routing and FFT schedule; Chafik Boukhalfa for certified phases; Cinna Davis for the later caller; and the classical Fourier, LDU and perturbation methods. Our PR4178 tensor precision protocol remains a separate predecessor. Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation and writing. Internal agents belong to the author process. Apache-2.0.
